- [2026-10-13] **When CIMS returns at least one verified-connection record for a CaseNetwork node's `realEntityId`, render current-case nodes with a clearer yellow background and expanded verified nodes with a more muted gray-yellow background, even when the linked detection record is not present in the graph.**
  Why: The user confirmed that any verified connection qualifies and clarified that current-case verified nodes should be more visually prominent than expanded verified nodes; CIMS is the source of truth for those records.
